description: End-to-end golden conversations for the SkyMind chatbot, scored on the reply a user receives from /api/chat.
notes: 'full' is every record; 'smoke' is the subset tagged smoke.
Live-data cases use relative dates ('in 14 days') so the corpus does not expire.
Knowledge references describe typical Indian domestic rules as of 2026; airline policies change, so review them when a case starts failing on content.
